article.hook: Someone just said something wildly off base - and called it gospel. Mercury in Sagittarius turns the room into a battleground for belief versus fact. Are you ready to call it or let it slide?
article.lived: Over the next few weeks, conversations stretch from small talk to the meaning behind it all. We chase ideas that cross continents and centuries, mixing stories with sharp questions. The pace pushes us to jump ahead, speaking before every detail lands, racing toward the next horizon. You might notice emails or texts that fire off with confidence but miss the fine print or context.
article.turn: The bigger the vision, the easier it is to bulldoze details or facts that don’t fit the story. Blunt honesty becomes a hammer, not a tool - and quick judgments overwrite curiosity. When belief becomes the only truth you’ll hear, the conversation shuts down rather than opens up.
